description: Avoid deprecated Node.js APIs, such as new Buffer() or the domain module; they may be removed and usually have safer replacements.

violation.message: Replace the removed internal _linklist module with your own linked list or an npm package.
Replace the internal _stream_wrap module with the public stream or net APIs.
Replace async_hooks currentId or triggerId with executionAsyncId() or triggerAsyncId().
Re-export only the names you use from async_hooks: this export * also re-exports async_hooks.currentId, which is deprecated.
Re-export only the names you use from async_hooks: this export * also re-exports async_hooks.triggerId, which is deprecated.
Replace this Buffer constructor or SlowBuffer with Buffer.from(), Buffer.alloc() or Buffer.allocUnsafeSlow().
Re-export only the names you use from buffer: this export * also re-exports buffer.SlowBuffer, which is deprecated.
Replace the constants module with the module's own constants, such as os.constants or fs.constants.
Replace this deprecated crypto API with a supported one, such as createCipheriv() or randomBytes().
